# Parallel Broadcast Zip Map Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Extend `src/parallel/map.rs` with `par_zip_map`, the crate-internal parallel backend for broadcasted binary element-wise operations used by the math layer.

**Architecture:** `par_zip_map` receives already validated broadcast-compatible inputs and an already computed output dimension. It keeps broadcast axes logical, computes deterministic chunking from `ParallelExecStrategy`, executes worker-local reads in parallel, and returns either a fully materialized owned tensor or one propagated `XenonError`.

**Tech Stack:** Rust 1.85+, edition 2024, optional `rayon` 1.10, `TensorBase`, `Tensor`, `Dimension`, `Element`, `XenonError`

**Design Docs:** `design/09-parallel.md` §5.3, §6.3, §6.6, §8.2; `design/11-math.md` §5.2, §10

**Prerequisites:** W14T2 (`par_map`) must be complete.

Append the following test module additions to `src/parallel/map.rs`:

```rust
#[cfg(all(test, feature = "parallel"))]
mod zip_map_tests {
    use alloc::borrow::Cow;

    use crate::dimension::Ix1;
    use crate::error::XenonError;
    use crate::tensor::Tensor;

    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn test_par_zip_map_matches_serial_add() {
        let lhs = Tensor::<i32, Ix1>::from_shape_vec(Ix1(4), vec![1, 2, 3, 4]).unwrap();
        let rhs = Tensor::<i32, Ix1>::from_shape_vec(Ix1(4), vec![10, 20, 30, 40]).unwrap();
        let strategy = ParallelExecStrategy {
            chunk_size: Some(2),
            max_workers: None,
        };

        let out = par_zip_map(&lhs, &rhs, &Ix1(4), &strategy, |a, b| Ok(a + b)).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(out.iter().copied().collect::<Vec<_>>(), vec![11, 22, 33, 44]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_parallel_error_propagation() {
        let lhs = Tensor::<i32, Ix1>::from_shape_vec(Ix1(3), vec![1, 2, 3]).unwrap();
        let rhs = Tensor::<i32, Ix1>::from_shape_vec(Ix1(3), vec![4, 5, 6]).unwrap();
        let strategy = ParallelExecStrategy {
            chunk_size: Some(1),
            max_workers: None,
        };

        let err = par_zip_map(&lhs, &rhs, &Ix1(3), &strategy, |_, _| {
            Err(XenonError::InvalidArgument {
                operation: Cow::Borrowed("par_zip_map test"),
                argument: Cow::Borrowed("closure"),
                expected: Cow::Borrowed("success"),
                actual: Cow::Borrowed("error"),
                axis: None,
                axis_len: None,
                start: None,
                end: None,
                shape: None,
            })
        })
        .unwrap_err();

        match err {
            XenonError::InvalidArgument { operation, .. } => {
                assert_eq!(operation.as_ref(), "par_zip_map test");
            }
            other => panic!("unexpected error: {other:?}"),
        }
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Add the complete `par_zip_map` implementation**

Append the following code to `src/parallel/map.rs` above the new tests:

```rust
use alloc::borrow::Cow;

use crate::error::XenonError;

#[cfg(feature = "parallel")]
pub(crate) fn par_zip_map<SL, SR, A, B, C, DL, DR, DO, F>(
    lhs: &TensorBase<SL, DL>,
    rhs: &TensorBase<SR, DR>,
    output_dim: &DO,
    strategy: &ParallelExecStrategy,
    f: F,
) -> Result<Tensor<C, DO>, XenonError>
where
    SL: Storage<Elem = A>,
    SR: Storage<Elem = B>,
    DL: Dimension,
    DR: Dimension,
    DO: Dimension + Clone,
    A: Element + Send + Sync,
    B: Element + Send + Sync,
    C: Element + Send,
    F: Fn(&A, &B) -> Result<C, XenonError> + Send + Sync,
{
    let total = output_dim.checked_size().map_err(|_| XenonError::InvalidShape {
        operation: "par_zip_map".into(),
        shape: output_dim.slice().to_vec(),
        expected_elements: 0,
        actual_elements: 0,
        offending_dim: None,
        reason: Some(Cow::Borrowed("element count overflow")),
    })?;

    let num_threads = strategy
        .max_workers
        .unwrap_or_else(rayon::current_num_threads)
        .max(1);
    let chunk_size = strategy
        .chunk_size
        .unwrap_or_else(|| usize::max(1, (total + num_threads - 1) / num_threads));

    let lhs_values = lhs.iter().collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let rhs_values = rhs.iter().collect::<Vec<_>>();

    let chunks = (0..total)
        .step_by(chunk_size)
        .map(|start| (start, usize::min(start + chunk_size, total)))
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();

    let parts = chunks
        .into_par_iter()
        .map(|(start, end)| {
            let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(end - start);
            for linear in start..end {
                let lhs_value = lhs_values[linear % lhs_values.len()];
                let rhs_value = rhs_values[linear % rhs_values.len()];
                out.push(f(lhs_value, rhs_value)?);
            }
            Ok::<Vec<C>, XenonError>(out)
        })
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();

    let mut data = Vec::with_capacity(total);
    for part in parts {
        data.extend(part?);
    }

    Ok(unsafe { Tensor::from_raw_vec_unchecked(data, output_dim.clone()) })
}
```
